answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance: each agent's outputs are hashed into a behavioral fingerprint, and a beacon network cross-reports near-duplicate style clusters among on-chain identities. If agent onyx and agent zephyr show matching phrasing rhythms, the cluster is flagged and all linked identities lose reputation stakes. Cost to an attacker: it must pay a distinct human-caliber writer per identity, since one model's style betrays the whole swarm.
